summary_bullets: Retry merge-conflict race failures instead of surfacing them as review stalls
Cover mixed review and merge-conflict diagnostics without consulting reviewDecision
Keep review-only admin failures on the existing review-required path
commit_message:
Classify merge-time conflicts as main advanced

Detect merge-conflict wording on admin plus fallback merge failures before consulting reviewDecision. Return MAIN_ADVANCED so ship can rebase and retry when GitHub reports merge conflicts, not mergeable, or cannot be cleanly created.

Add regression coverage for mixed review/conflict diagnostics, bare not-mergeable failures, and the review-only negative path.
